title: אלעזר זעירא

paragraphs: Elazar Ze'ira wore black shoes in Nehardea’s market. The exilarch’s men asked, “Are you important enough to mourn Jerusalem?” Elazar said Shmuel was alive and his court was still sitting. The exilarch’s men sent the question to Shmuel, who confirmed Elazar’s ruling (Hakones 59b). Yuchasin’s “Resh Lakish seized him to test whether worthy of this presumption” is an error: R.L. instead of R.G. [ר״ל/ר״ג; disputed initials retained]. It adds Ammi and Assi before Yitzchak Nappacha (60b), unrelated to Elazar Ze'ira, an error. A great sage; his learned, pious student Abba bar Zimna—see there: mistaken.
